notes: Gold labels are synthetic; metrics measure against that distribution.

The 'glm' run is HISTORICAL: captured 2026-10-19 via the build environment's GLM gateway (served glm-4-plus), before the live provider migrated to Groq (decision.md D-026). Rerun live with: python evals/run_eval.py --provider groq

no_grounding.interpretation: Classification deltas on n=10 are within run-to-run variance (agreement 100%) — grounding is not an accuracy feature by design. What grounding adds: 100% of service matches carry catalog evidence + source URL (0% in the ablation), and confidence is calibrated against lexical support (low-support picks flagged).
